course.en: Indian food is Indian, of course. But British Indian food can also be British.
course.zh: 印度食物当然是印度的。但英国印度食物也可以是英国的。

course.en: Of course, spent nuclear fuel is dangerous, and it remains radioactive for thousands of years.
course.zh: 当然，乏核燃料确实很危险，而且它的放射性会持续数千年。

course.en: Even in countries that haven't reversed course entirely, the tone has changed.
course.zh: 即使在没有彻底掉头的国家，基调也变了。

course.en: OK. Well, we're going to start with a quiz question of course, Georgie.
course.zh: OK. Well, we're going to start with a quiz question of course, Georgie.

course.en: And of course, British aristocrats copied them.
course.zh: 当然，英国贵族效仿了他们。

conclude.en: So, Henning concludes that yes, you can catch a scratch, just like you might catch an illness.
conclude.zh: So, Henning concludes that yes, you can catch a scratch, just like you might catch an illness.

conclude.en: And increasingly, governments have concluded that nuclear and renewables need to work together, with nuclear providing the steady backbone that a renewable -heavy grid needs to actually function.
conclude.zh: 越来越多的政府得出结论：核能和可再生能源需要协同工作，由核能提供稳定的骨干支撑，以使依赖可再生能源的电网能够真正运转。

context.en: To put it in context, this is more electricity than the entire Netherlands uses in a year.
context.zh: 从大局来看，这比整个荷兰一年的用电量还要多。

context.en: Catch in this context means get from someone else.
context.zh: Catch in this context means get from someone else.

concept.en: If you unpack an idea or scientific concept, you explain it in clear detail.
concept.zh: If you unpack an idea or scientific concept, you explain it in clear detail.

confident.en: I'm not a socially anxious person – I think I'm really confident.
confident.zh: 我不是个有社交焦虑的人——我认为自己其实很自信。

confident.en: Deliberately looking for rejection might be an extreme way to become more confident, but it can lead to surprising discoveries.
confident.zh: 故意寻求拒绝也许是建立自信的一种极端方式，但它可能会带来令人惊喜的发现。

confidence.en: But people who post the videos say they boost their confidence.
confidence.zh: 但发布视频的人表示，这确实增强了他们的自信心。

counter.en: And so, I wonder whether that might make people more shy of speaking to strangers – worried that the people will, you know, not appraise them in a good way, and so doing something like this to try to counter that might feel like a positive step to people, that they're trying to do something.
counter.zh: 所以我在想，这是否会让大家更羞于与陌生人交谈——担心别人对自己的评价不高。因此，通过做这样的事情来对抗这种心理，大家可能会觉得是一种积极的尝试，至少说明他们在做出努力。

commerce.en: In January of this year, January of 2026, the German Chancellor, Friedrich Merz, stood in front of the Chamber of Industry and Commerce in Dessau and admitted, in no uncertain terms , that his country, Germany, had made a mistake.
commerce.zh: 今年1月，也就是2026年1月，德国总理 Friedrich Merz 站在德绍工商会面前，毫不含糊地承认他的国家——德国，犯了一个错误。

commit.en: Belgium is one example. In 2003, Belgium passed a law committing itself to shutting down every nuclear reactor in the country.
commit.zh: 比利时就是一个例子。2003年，比利时通过了一项法律，承诺关闭该国所有的核反应堆。

commit.en: In any case, never before has so much private money been committed to nuclear energy, and we are only six years into the decade.
commit.zh: 无论如何，历史上从未有如此多的私人资金投入到核能领域，而这个十年才刚刚过去六年。

consensus.en: It was broadly the same story as Germany: public fear after Chernobyl, a strong Green movement, and a political consensus that nuclear power belonged to the past.
consensus.zh: 这与德国的情况大体相同：切尔诺贝利事故后的公众恐慌、强大的绿党运动，以及核电属于过去的政治共识。

completely.en: It repealed the law completely, cancelling it as if it had never existed.
completely.zh: 它彻底废除了这项法律，将其撤销，就像它从未存在过一样。

completely.en: Some foods were completely unavailable. This produced a very unusual food culture.
completely.zh: 有些食物完全买不到。这产生了一种非常不寻常的饮食文化。

completely.en: This stereotype is not completely new. British people themselves have made jokes about their country’s food for years.
completely.zh: 这种刻板印象并非完全新鲜。英国人自己多年来一直拿他们国家的食物开玩笑。

confirm.en: Italy banned nuclear power after Chernobyl, and confirmed that ban again after Fukushima, when 94% of voters rejected building new reactors .
confirm.zh: 意大利在切尔诺贝利事故后禁止了核电，并在福岛事故后再次确认了这一禁令，当时94%的选民投票反对建造新反应堆。

courtesy.en: And yes, this episode and my voice today are brought to you courtesy of your local data centre.
courtesy.zh: 是的，今天的这期节目和我的声音，正是由你当地的数据中心为你呈现的。

constraint.en: So the world's biggest technology companies did something unexpected, or I guess rather obvious when you understand that electricity is their biggest constraint .
constraint.zh: 于是，全球最大的科技公司做了一件出人意料的事，或者说，当你明白电力是他们最大的瓶颈时，这其实是顺理成章的。

comfortable.en: Of course, not everyone is comfortable with that shift.
comfortable.zh: 当然，并不是每个人都对这种转变感到安心。

comfortable.en: People had to make use of almost everything available to them, including eating parts of animals that we might be less comfortable eating today.
comfortable.zh: 人们必须利用几乎所有可用的东西，包括吃今天我们可能不太乐意吃的动物部位。

construction.en: And small modular reactors , which I mentioned a few minutes ago, are another way to fight the issues that have plagued the construction of these large nuclear power plants.
construction.zh: 而我几分钟前提到的小型模块化反应堆，则是解决困扰这些大型核电站建设难题的另一种途径。

commercial.en: There's an SMR in China which is scheduled to start commercial operation in the next 12 months, and others being built in Canada and America.
commercial.zh: 中国有一座 SMR 计划在未来12个月内投入商业运行，加拿大和美国也在建造其他反应堆。

condition.en: If anything goes wrong, the conditions collapse and the reaction simply stops.
condition.zh: 一旦出现任何差错，反应条件便会瓦解，反应直接停止。

condition.en: It only happens under extreme conditions, and there is only ever a tiny amount of fuel in the machine.
condition.zh: 它只能在极端条件下发生，而且机器内部的燃料量微乎其微。

collapse.en: If anything goes wrong, the conditions collapse and the reaction simply stops.
collapse.zh: 一旦出现任何差错，反应条件便会瓦解，反应直接停止。

comment.en: Let me know in the comments below, if you're listening to this somewhere where you can comment, and for the members among you, you can head right into our community forum, which is at community.leonardoenglish.com and get chatting away to other curious minds.
comment.zh: 如果你收听节目的地方可以评论，欢迎在下方留言；对于会员朋友，你们可以直接前往我们的社区论坛 community.leonardoenglish.com，与其他求知欲强烈的听友交流畅聊。

community.en: Fried fish has connections to Jewish communities who came to Britain from Spain and Portugal.
community.zh: 炸鱼与从西班牙和葡萄牙来到英国的犹太社区有联系。

community.en: For centuries, many rural communities had access to common land, right?
community.zh: 几个世纪以来，许多农村社区都可以使用公共土地，对吧？

compare.en: But compare that to places with great food cultures.
compare.zh: 但将此与拥有伟大饮食文化的地方进行比较。

compare.en: British cuisine is often compared unfavourably with the food of countries such as France, Italy, Spain, or Japan.
compare.zh: 英国菜经常被拿来与法国、意大利、西班牙或日本等国家的食物进行不利的比较。

common.en: One of the most common criticisms of British food is that it is bland .
common.zh: 对英国食物最常见的批评之一是它很平淡。

common.en: Landowners enclosed common land. Fences and boundaries were built around the land.
common.zh: 地主们圈占了公共土地。土地周围修建了篱笆和边界。

consider.en: The first thing to understand is that British food wasn’t always considered bad.
consider.zh: 要理解的第一件事是，英国食物并不总是被认为是不好的。

consider.en: Consider Germany, where the doner kebab is an enormously popular fast food.
consider.zh: 想想德国，多纳烤肉（doner kebab）在那里是一种非常受欢迎的快餐。

comparable.en: In fact, in the 16th century, English food was comparable , similar, to the food being eaten by ordinary people in Europe.
comparable.zh: 事实上，在16世纪，英国食物与欧洲普通人吃的食物相当、相似。

contain.en: Aristocratic meals contained enormous quantities of meat, elaborate dishes, sugar, and imported spices.
contain.zh: 贵族的膳食包含大量的肉类、精致的菜肴、糖和进口香料。

contain.en: This could contain vegetables and grains and, if times were good, maybe a little bit of meat or fish.
contain.zh: 这可能包含蔬菜和谷物，如果赶上好时候，也许还有一点肉或鱼。

cow.en: People would also potentially have dairy products from cows and sheep, and perhaps keep chickens or other animals.
cow.zh: 人们还可能拥有来自牛和羊的乳制品，也许还养鸡或其他动物。

cow.en: If you lose access to the land where you keep your cows and grow your vegetables, you lose the system that allows you to feed yourself.
cow.zh: 如果你失去了饲养奶牛和种植蔬菜的土地的使用权，你就失去了让你能够养活自己的系统。

complicated.en: Something more complicated, though, started to happen from the 17th century onwards.
complicated.zh: 然而，从17世纪开始，更复杂的事情开始发生。

complicated.en: Its reputation has a complicated history.
complicated.zh: 它的名声背后有着一段复杂的历史。

continue.en: But if your grandparents learned to cook during food rationing, your parents would have grown up eating simple meals, and those habits continue and get transferred down society.
continue.zh: 但如果你的祖父母是在食物配给期间学会烹饪的，你的父母就会在吃简单饭菜的环境中长大，而这些习惯会延续并代代相传。

continue.en: But the food of ordinary people continued to be based on local ingredients and traditional recipes By the 18th century, some British writers were already complaining about this trend, criticizing wealthy British people who preferred French cooks to English ones.
continue.zh: 但普通人的食物继续以本地食材和传统食谱为基础。到了18世纪，一些英国作家已经开始抱怨这种趋势，批评那些宁愿要法国厨师也不要英国厨师的富有英国人。

complain.en: Don’t just go to the supermarket and buy a sandwich and complain that British food is bad.
complain.zh: 不要只去超市买个三明治然后抱怨英国食物不好。

complain.en: When I studied in London, I had two friends from France and Spain who used to complain about British food all the time.
complain.zh: 在伦敦求学时，我有两个分别来自法国和西班牙的朋友，他们过去总是在抱怨英国食物。

collect.en: People could use this land for animals or to grow food or to collect resources such as firewood.
collect.zh: 人们可以把这块土地用于饲养动物、种植食物或收集木柴等资源。

convenience.en: The post-war decades saw the growth of processed food and convenience food: frozen vegetables, canned food, instant meals, microwave meals.
convenience.zh: 战后几十年见证了加工食品和便利食品的增长：冷冻蔬菜、罐头食品、即食餐、微波炉食品。

connection.en: Fried fish has connections to Jewish communities who came to Britain from Spain and Portugal.
connection.zh: 炸鱼与从西班牙和葡萄牙来到英国的犹太社区有联系。

contemporary.en: And if you want to see the modern British food revival, go to a great gastropub or a contemporary British restaurant.
contemporary.zh: 如果你想看到现代英国食物的复兴，去一个伟大的美食酒吧或当代英国餐厅。
